predicate.label: professor or university teacher at
predicate.definition: Person X is a professor or teaches at academic institution Y.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit professor; teaching at the institution; historical teaching affiliation. Excludes: expert/specialist/dean/researcher/analyst alone; attendance or institution location alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear teacher versus student attachment.

rationale: Three professor paths tie director/head/oversight contexts; the two-count explicit professor-at path resolves the tie over management singletons.
